mil7.6.10:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, ajagarassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.6.10:1.2: Yathā mahārāja ajagaro mahatimahākāyo bahū pi divase ūnūdaro dīnataro kucchipūraṃ āhāraṃ na labhati, aparipuṇṇo yeva yāvad-eva sarīrayāpanamattakena yāpeti,
mil7.6.10:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yogino yogāvacarassa bhikkhācariyapasutassa parapiṇḍam-upagatassa paradinnapāṭikankhissa sayaṃgāhapaṭiviratassa dullabhaṃ udaraparipūraṃ āhāraṃ, api ca atthavasikena kulaputtena cattāro pañca ālope abhuñjitvā avasesaṃ udakena paripūretabbaṃ.
mil7.6.10:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja ajagarassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.10:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
